name: Beat Bartleby
summary: In Stormwind, Beat Bartleby keeps a prized mug from the warrior instructors. He will not give it up, so a recruit must win it in a brawl.

sections.title: A Brawler's Challenge
sections.body: The warrior instructors make no claim that combat is noble or grand. Bartleby swears no one will take his prized mug without prying it from his cold, dead fingers. So you settle the matter with your fists. For a fledgling warrior, words give way to a brawl.

sections.title: A Drunken Lesson
sections.body: Bartleby boasts that he will fight to the death, but a thorough thrashing sobers him. Bruised admiration replaces his bravado when he sees your strength, and he yields peacefully. You can take the mug to the training hall and complete your trial.

faq.answer: Bartleby is a belligerent drunkard who frequents Stormwind City. He clings to a beloved drinking vessel and tests novice warriors sent to prove their physical resolve.

faq.q: Why do I have to fight Bartleby?
faq.answer: Alliance warrior trainers send recruits to recover a mug Bartleby holds. He refuses to give it up without a brawl, so you must defeat him hand to hand to claim it.

faq.q: Do I actually kill Bartleby in this quest?
faq.answer: No. Bartleby boasts that you must pry the mug from his cold, dead fingers, but he surrenders when beaten and admits you are tougher than he expected.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place in Stormwind, where Bartleby drinks and loiters.

faq.q: What happens after I defeat him?
faq.answer: After you beat him, Bartleby yields and speaks to you amicably. You can take his mug back to the warrior trainers and complete your initiation.

faq.q: What level of training does this trial represent?
faq.answer: This brawl is an early milestone for fledgling warriors around their tenth season of experience. It tests basic endurance in hand-to-hand combat.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you face an early tavern brawl and learn that force of will and a heavy fist can settle disputes when diplomacy fails.
In Stormwind's capital streets, you glimpse the city's rough underbelly alongside its stately stone walls.
